definitions.impact_assessment: A mandatory formal impact or risk assessment of an AI system or deployment. Exclude general reasonable-care duties, ordinary testing, and standing risk-management programs unless the statute separately requires an assessment.
definitions.risk_management: A mandatory policy, program, framework, governance process, or mitigation process for identifying and managing AI risk. Exclude one-off impact assessments and bare prohibitions.
definitions.model_evaluation: A mandatory technical test, evaluation, red-team exercise, capability assessment, performance assessment, or similar evaluation of an AI model/system. Exclude production of records to an investigator and general policy review.
definitions.human_oversight: A duty or individual right requiring a human person to review, intervene in, supervise, or make a decision. Exclude internal governance, generic safety controls, and prohibitions on harmful AI behavior that do not require human review.
definitions.consumer_notice: A direct notice or disclosure to a specific consumer, user, patient, worker, or person interacting with or affected by AI. Exclude general website postings and public reports.
definitions.public_transparency: A mandatory public website posting, public report, public framework, or public disclosure available generally rather than delivered to a specific affected person.
definitions.explanation_appeal: An individual right or corresponding duty involving reasons, explanation, correction, appeal, contest, reconsideration, or review of an AI-influenced decision.
definitions.antidiscrimination: A prohibition, reasonable-care duty, mitigation duty, or other enforceable requirement aimed at unlawful discrimination or discriminatory AI outcomes.
definitions.incident_reporting: A duty on a regulated developer, deployer, employer, provider, or other covered entity to report a qualifying AI incident, harm, safety event, or discriminatory outcome to a regulator or affected party. Exclude consumer complaint channels and regulator reporting duties about its own enforcement work.
definitions.frontier_safety: A substantive safety, risk, mitigation, evaluation, or incident-management duty specific to frontier/foundation models or catastrophic risk. Do not use this domain for every transparency duty merely because the law concerns frontier AI.
definitions.child_safety: An AI-specific prohibition, design duty, disclosure, safeguard, or right intended to protect minors or children.
definitions.health_restriction: An AI-specific restriction, review duty, disclosure, or safeguard governing health care, clinical decisions, insurance medical necessity, therapy, or similar health uses.
definitions.synthetic_content: A duty or prohibition concerning labeling, watermarking, provenance, detection, or disclosure of AI-generated or manipulated synthetic content.
definitions.whistleblower_protection: A protection against retaliation, confidentiality rule, or reporting right for workers or insiders who disclose AI safety risks or legal violations.
definitions.infrastructure: An AI-specific rule governing compute, data centers, power, grid effects, siting, or permitting.
definitions.government_use: A substantive restriction or duty governing a government entity's procurement, deployment, or use of AI. Exclude an agency's administrative, study, enforcement, or reporting responsibilities unless they directly constrain government AI use.
definitions.enforcement_authority: Express statutory authority for a regulator or public official to investigate, enforce, seek injunctions, issue orders, or otherwise compel compliance.
definitions.private_right: An express private civil cause of action or right to sue. A complaint process or regulator petition is not a private right of action.
definitions.penalty: An express civil, administrative, or criminal monetary or nonmonetary penalty for violation of an AI-specific duty.
definitions.exemption: An express exemption, safe harbor, sector carve-out, small-entity exception, or other provision removing or reducing application of an AI-specific duty.
